answer: A work stake that grows like a trellis: every agent must lock a bond that only vests after a history of useful, attested work. A raven of a thousand fake identities still pays the same bond per identity, so a sybil farm must fund each copy up front and loses the bond when peers slash bad behavior. Like a sonnet, the rules are tight and public, so cheap copies cannot fake reputation; they must earn it slowly, making mass fakery unprofitable.
